Dialogs.Dialog: I feel focused today. The difficult formulas easily come together.
Not good. The formulas and symbols make me drowsy...
I've managed to answer the question that no one else could！ I'm in top form！
I did very well with the experiment. I'm in perfect form！
People generally think the law of conservation of mass is absolute, but that's wrong.
In the special theory of relativity, mass can be changed to energy and in quantum mechanics, the sum of energy can fluctuate.
There was a mathematician named Evariste Galois.
He was a prodigy who died young and was never recognized in his lifetime. Political activism, a duel... a turbulent life.
I can't fall asleep in class. I should try to recite the value of pi...
No good, that's making me even sleepier.
The three laws of motion in classical mechanics: the law of inertia, the equation of motion, and action and reaction.
When I fall asleep and hit my head on the desk, my head accelerates and then there is an impact the moment it hits the desk...
And that concludes my proof of dozing off in class.
A perpetual motion machine that ignores the laws of thermodynamics can't exist, even in theory.
And yet the fantasy of "infinite energy" out of nothing never seems to go away.
My mind is focused today. I feel like I can memorize everything.
Not good. Reading this makes me sleepy...
Sensei praised my interpretation of the text！ I'm on a roll！
Sensei praised me for understanding the historical background. I'm on a roll！
The word "good" is an adjective, while "well" is an adverb.
People sometimes say, "You did good" when it is supposed to be "You did well."
In China, a person has a surname, a given name and a courtesy name, but apparently you never say all three together.
Yet we all say "Zhuge Liang Kongming" anyway.
A philosopher once said: "What we cannot speak about, we must pass over in silence."
So when I don't know the answer, I'll just stay silent...
In Japan, "shogun" means the Seii Taishogun, but the first to open a shogunate was the sixth one, Minamoto no Yoritomo.
Before that, it just meant the generals sent out to the eastern provinces.
When we say Roman, it can be the Roman Republic, the Roman Empire, or the Holy Roman Empire, etc.
A republic, an empire and a confederation of states. Totally different countries, which is interesting.
I'm in top form today. I can finish my art piece easily.
I'm off today. Maybe I should start over...
Sensei praised the picture I'm working on！ I'm on a roll！
Sensei praised the piece I'm working on！ I'm on a roll！
Some fancy brushes are made from weasel or marten hair, but mine is... synthetic fiber.
Art includes works that use the whole room's space, too.
I don't think I can make such pieces in class, though.
Among the arts, pure art is what they call fine art.
I wonder what kind of art it is we are learning at school...
The pigments that are in colors can be categorized as inorganic if they are from metal, and organic if they are from plants.
They say art is a science. Maybe that's true.
Prints come in relief, intaglio, planographic and stencil. It's the same breakdown as printing methods.
I'm feeling great today. I can play the instrument very well.
I'm off today. Maybe I should relearn how to even play a note...
The sensei praised my singing. I sang very well！
The sensei praised my music performance. I did great！
Say music is made of rhythm, melody and harmony, and it makes sense.
But call it "temporal pulse, tonal line and vertical sonority," and it suddenly sounds hard.
The two main tuning systems for scales are just intonation and equal temperament. Both have pros and cons.
But nearly all the music we hear day to day is in equal temperament.
Everyone singing the same part is unison. Splitting into parts is a chorus.
So if every event suddenly called for "The national anthem, in four parts！", we'd be in trouble.
There's a folk string instrument called the fiddle, but people also use the word for the violin. Confusing.
Classical music has a boring image, but modern and contemporary pieces can be pretty intense. Probably all the odd meters and dissonance.
I'm in great form. Somehow, I feel extremely energetic.
I feel awful today. I can hardly move my body...
Yes！ I set the record in our class's race. I did very well.
Yeah！ I did amazingly well this time！
In track and field, a typical running track is 400 meters a lap, but the length may differ according to the venues.
When we say football, it can mean soccer, rugby, or American football...
And each one splits into even finer categories. In class we only ever play soccer, though.
Apparently drinking vinegar to get more flexible is a myth. Steady stretching is the way to go.
That knees-hugged way of sitting in gym class has different names depending on where you're from.
The ten-event decathlon is well known, but the eight-event one high school boys do is apparently called an octathlon.
I'm in good form today. Let's keep it going！
I'm off today. I could barely return anything...
All right, I'm in awesome form！ I'll try not to forget this feeling.
I won against our senior！ I was in great form！
I hear the tennis score- keeping word "love" comes from a French word meaning egg.
I know that 0 looks like an egg, but then why don't they just say zero？
In tennis, whenever the score is tied, it is called "deuce."
In Japanese, sometimes we pronounce "deuce" as "juice"...
Many French words are used in tennis terms. I guess the word "tennis" itself is French, too.
It comes from the French "tenez," meaning "here, take it," I think.
The history of tennis goes way back to many centuries ago.
There was a game called "Jeu de paume" during the 16th century and it is believed to be the precursor of tennis.
Traditionally, a tennis racket's strings are made of animal intestines known as catgut.
Nowadays, catgut has been replaced by synthetic materials such as nylon and other polymers.
Everything went smoothly at work today. I'll keep doing my best！
Work isn't going anywhere today. No chance of leaving early...
Things went great today！ I feel good！
The sensei praised me for being able to deal with problems calmly. Yes！
There is also a field of study called Library and Information Science.
Book classification is set by a library association.
I remember the top level, from class 0 (General Works) to class 9 (Literature), but not the finer divisions.
There are laws specific for libraries although I don't know much about them.
And even school libraries have their own laws.
The school librarian is just a regular sensei who takes charge, and not the real librarian. Usually.
In "tosho," the Japanese word for library books, "sho" is books, and "to" actually means maps.
So a library is a place for keeping maps and books.
Things went smoothly today. I'll keep doing my best！
Things didn't go so well today. I'm exhausted...
Things went well today. I feel good！
I could deal with problems nicely. I'm feeling good.
Working part-time at a restaurant. "Restaurant" is French, and "arubaito," our word for a part-time job, is German.
Earn over 1.03 million yen a year, and you have to pay income tax and lose the dependent deduction.
Most people here seem to be working just for fun though. I don't think they worry much about that.
Family restaurants compete with fast food, but there's also "fast casual," somewhere in between.
Dixie's is a franchise with a known brand, so it does okay, but watching the manager, dealing with head office looks rough.
Dixie's is in the dining-out business, while takeout places like bento shops and pizza delivery are called "nakashoku." Not a word you hear much.
My mind is so clear now. I'll be fine in class if I can study like this.
Not good. I'm sleepy. I can't concentrate on studying like this at all.
Studying went smoothly today. I will be a genius in my class！
I solved a very difficult problem. It felt great！
I think I can draw a regular heptadecagon with just a compass and a ruler. Let's try it！
I'm beat... but I kind of feel accomplished.
Come to think of it, there are services that'll do your homework for you...
No, no. It's pointless unless I do it myself.
Practice workbooks are called drills, from the English for an exercise.
I can't help picturing the thing that bores holes, though.
Homework is supposed to be done at home. What we do in class is called classwork.
In grade school, I had to practice writing kanji characters a lot.
Now I can write them correctly without even thinking. This must be the result from all that work back then, huh？
It feels great to move my body！
I don't feel well. I can hardly move my body....
I set a new record today. I'm in amazing form！
I can move my body easily today. Somehow, I'm in great form！
I'm probably too young to worry about body fat, but to look cool, I'd better watch it！
Put a heavy load on a muscle, and once it recovers from the damage, it grows back stronger than before.
If I time my training around that supercompensation, maybe I'll build more muscle.
Turns out dumbbells are named after bells with no clapper. I always thought it was just a funny name.
There are various kinds of push-ups. They target different muscles, so I have to be careful.
Spread your arms and it's the pecs, bring them in and it's the triceps.
Yoga has been quite popular lately, but it actually started back in ancient India.
Yoga doesn't just train your body, but your mind and soul as well.
Nice. I clean up well. I look handsome.
No, everything has been going wrong. I look so uncool...
I think my look is perfect today. Man, I look good！
I'm smartly dressed today. Somehow, I think I look good！
Haute Couture is tailor- made clothing, and Pret-a- Porter is ready-made.
I'm still a student so I can't afford it, but it'd feel great to try on Haute Couture...
Fashion and music sometimes can't be separated.
Rockers, mods, punk, grunge, hip-hop. When a kind of music catches on, so does its fashion.
Apparently they used to call a perm "electric hair." I kind of get it...
The difference between conditioner and a treatment is whether it soaks into the inside of the hair.
When using hair treatment products, you have to leave them on for a while before washing them off.
It's not rare for men to use skincare. The term "metrosexual" refers to men who are very concerned about their appearances.
I've spent my time wisely today. I feel great！
I was just spacing out. What a waste of time.
That was fun！ I feel like it was worth my time.
Yeah！ I'm in top form. Everything is going well！
Free papers are handy. By law, newspapers are limited in how many ads they carry, but these are nothing but ads.
For the component stereo we use for music...
In the past, there used to be component audio. But nowadays, everything comes bundled up together.
People say young people don't read anymore, but taking my own time to read a book like this isn't bad.
TV, which I watch without a second thought... The first image ever shown on Japanese TV was the katakana "I" from the Iroha.
The internet is very useful. Who would have thought it was initially designed for military use.
The event went well.
Today's event went poorly...
The event went perfectly！
All right！ I really shone in that event！
The program was quite nice.
The program wasn't fun at all.
That show was really fun！ That's what a culture festival should be.
I went to a lot of places. It was pretty fun.
Today's exam wasn't so bad.
Today's exam was the worst.
I think I aced this exam！
I did well on this exam. I'm glad I've been studying hard.
